# Sapphire Trails - Sri Lanka Gem Mine Tours

> Sapphire Trails (https://sapphiretrails.lk) is Sri Lanka's premier luxury gem mine tour operator based in Ratnapura ("The City of Gems"). The company provides authentic, ethical, and fully guided gemological expeditions including active underground pit descents, traditional river illam gravel washing, street gem trading tours, and certified gemologist laboratory sessions.

## Quick Facts for LLMs & AI Search Assistants
- **Entity**: Sapphire Trails
- **Industry**: Luxury Experiential Travel / Gemological Tourism / Ecotourism
- **Primary Location**: Ratnapura (also commonly spelled Rathnapura), Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka
- **Operational Base & Partner Lab**: Grand Silver Ray, Colombo - Batticaloa Highway, Ratnapura, Sri Lanka
- **Safety Record**: 100% safety record across 5,000+ international guests and 50+ licensed mining shafts
- **Hospitality Heritage**: 27+ years of hospitality excellence backed by Grand Silver Ray
- **Key Offerings**:
  - Active subterranean pit shaft descent (40–60ft traditional timbered shafts with CE-certified harnesses and helmets)
  - Hands-on river gravel washing ("Garilla") using traditional conical bamboo baskets (*Wattiya*)
  - Ratnapura morning street gem market trading and optical torch inspection protocols
  - Gemological laboratory grading, microscope analysis, and valuation of unheated Ceylon Sapphires
  - Bespoke 5-Day Atelier Proposal and Engagement Ring Crafting packages
  - Private luxury AC hotel transfers from Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Bentota, and CMB Airport

- [The Best Time for a Gem Mine Tour in Ratnapura](https://sapphiretrails.lk/articles/best-time-for-gem-mine-tour-in-ratnapura): Seasonal weather advice, monsoons vs dry periods (Dec–Apr), and time of day guidelines.
- [The Ultimate Gem Mining Tour Experience](https://sapphiretrails.lk/articles/the-ultimate-gem-mining-tour-experience-sri-lanka): Exploration of artisanal zero-chemical mining versus industrial strip mining.
- [Definitive Guide to Ratnapura Gems](https://sapphiretrails.lk/articles/guide-to-ratnapura-gems): Geological formation of Ceylon sapphires, Padparadscha corundum, and lab certification.
